story.label: Opening
story.value: Meltwater runs between the standing stones. Beyond the sheltered farms, snow still fills the mountain cuts.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v1; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: The request
story.value: Alric brings the work to the party through Seers of the Northern Gods. Alric is the only survivor of a destroyed adventuring party.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v1; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: First expedition
story.value: Begin at Ruins of the Quiet Betrayer. Recover Ruby-eyed, gold idol, 3 Demonskin blessings (840 gp), in the disputed casket of the old claim. Recover Potion of Extirpation (360 gp), in the salvaged standard of the trade route. Each section has its own holder and marked threshold. The other listed sites are additional jobs in the same region.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v1; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: Stakes
story.value: The request has become a public test of the faction’s promises. Completing the objectives supplies a concrete result; abandoning them sends the dispute back to the assembly.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v1; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: At the table
story.value: The associated encounters use the listed reaction rolls. Treasure is allocated to the listed sites, but its discovery and access still need to be resolved in play. Tarot meanings are prompts; they do not add an unlisted power or compel an outcome.
story.source: Published dossier assembly and play policy

monster.name: Vampire
traits: Supreme Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by magical sources.
Blood Drain. Vampire heals 2d6 HP and target permanently loses 1d4 CON. At 0 CON, target dies and rises as vampire or vampire spawn (vampire chooses).
Charm. One humanoid target who can see vampire within near, DC 15 CHA or under vampire's control for 1d4 days.
Shapechange. In place of attacks, turn into a bat, wolf, or back into regular form.

Vampire. Must sleep in a coffin daily or loses 2d6 HP each day that can't be healed until resting in coffin. Takes 3d8 damage each round while in direct sunlight. Cannot be killed unless pierced through heart with a wooden stake while at 0 HP.
vulnerabilities: Coffin dependence: Must rest in a coffin daily or lose 2d6 HP per day; that loss cannot heal until coffin rest.
Direct sunlight: Takes 3d8 damage each round in direct sunlight.
Wooden stake at 0 HP: A wooden stake through the heart at 0 HP permits permanent death.
